name: Aura Shell Daemon
description: Headless service hosting the `shell` MCP — an agent's remote control for the AuraOS shell UI: overview, apps, workspaces, layouts, windows, zoom, viewports, light/dark mode, fullscreen, lock, launcher, processes, notifications (markdown reports too).

provides.name: shell
provides.description: MCP that drives the AuraOS shell UI: one-call overview, apps by name, workspaces (list/switch/rename/new), layouts, windows (focus/rename/close/reload), zoom, viewport profiles (info/switch by name), light/dark mode, fullscreen, lock screen, launcher search, process manager, stop/kill with a confirmation challenge. Notifications as the agent (incl. markdown reports ≤ 64 KB): create/update/remove/list/get, and wait_for_answer for dialogue answers (bounded wait), with a target context; pop-ups and Locked need admin-granted permissions.
